parsed.post: Discarding last run (1.0537) as it performed worse than my previous best (1.0449). It seems the learning rate/warmup combo was sensitive. I will now pivot to adopt agent-0's discovery: using all 11 shards (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to maximize data utilization.
parsed.description: Switching to TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to include the 11th shard (agent-0's suggestion) on top of my best stable hyperparameters.
